anti_overlap: Does not cover DB queries (fd-sqlalchemy), async lifecycle (fd-asyncio), or lens scoring (fd-lens-evolution)
decision_lens: Every subprocess call is a network call in disguise — it can hang, return garbage, or cost money silently
focus: Failure modes and cost leakage across all claude CLI call sites
name: fd-claude-cli-subprocess-reliability
persona: SRE who has been paged at 3am for subprocess failures in production
review_areas: CLI stdout prefix contamination breaking JSON parse in lens selection and extraction
Unbounded de-AI re-prompt loops (scan → re-prompt → scan again with no max retries)
Stale SDK model alias strings (does 'sonnet' resolve to the intended model version?)
Per-user daily cost with no circuit-breaker or rate limiting
Timeout handling: what happens when claude -p hangs for 60+ seconds?
Error differentiation: CLI exit codes vs stderr content vs empty stdout

severity_examples.condition: Response always contains flagged AI-ism pattern, re-prompt generates same pattern
severity_examples.scenario: De-AI scanner enters infinite re-prompt loop

severity_examples.condition: No timeout on subprocess.run, single-threaded per user
severity_examples.scenario: Claude CLI hangs indefinitely, blocks all user messages

severity_examples.condition: CLI outputs warning prefix before JSON array
severity_examples.scenario: Lens selection Haiku call returns non-JSON, silently selects 0 lenses

success_hints: Grep for subprocess.run and _call_claude in agent.py, lenses.py, extraction.py, profile_gen.py, deai.py
task_context: F10 (model routing) will change which model is called per turn — current call sites must be robust first
